name: Tempester n°51: Roll repeats on the grid when stopped; the Momentary Roll footswitch follows the pedal
explanation: Tempester n°51: Roll repeats on the grid with the sequencer stopped; the Momentary Roll footswitch follows the pedal (Main 1.5.0.2). Before: stopped, Roll / arpeggio repeats are counted by the main loop: [routine] walks the ticks the sequencer counter [address] has advanced since the last walk ([address], positions modulo the beat length) and counts down byte +7 of each panel pad record ([address] + pad * 0x14); at 1 it retriggers the pad and reloads the count ([routine]: the grid [address][quantize], at 1/16 24 + / - swing by the parity bit +8). The pad press loaded the full grid ([routine], 3 sites, Pad Function modes 2 (16 Sounds), 3 and 5), so the repeats ran at the press phase, off the click; and the walk counted one tick too many at each loop of the beat (its position took the value of the length before 0), so the repeats moved one tick earlier at every loop. Pedal: case 6 of the footswitch event (« Momentary Roll ») called [routine](ctx, Roll off) on both edges, a toggle: with Roll latched on, the pedal turned it off while held; a beat change (which clears Roll, ctx+0x28) while held left Roll stuck on at the release. Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §4. After: NOW / RELOAD load the count of ticks to the next grid point from the current position t: c = Q - (t mod P) while below Q, else P - (t mod P), with P = Q = grid, or at 1/16 P = 48 and Q = 24 + swing (the swung sixteenth, as [routine] plays it); c is capped at the beat end (length - t) so a loop that is not a whole number of grid steps restarts on the beat. The press sites use t = [address] mod length (the next walk starts there); the reload after a retrigger uses the position the walk reached (s5 + 1). The walk ends its position at length - 1. Footswitch: pressed = Roll on, released = Roll off, nothing when Roll is already in that state (ctx+0x28). Playing (Timer 4 rolls) unchanged: the walk only retriggers when stopped. Context: main loop (UI and [routine]). No RAM. Free flash 0x9D07AAF0-0x9D07ABBF (52 words), 14 words in place; [routine] (one caller) is no longer reached; the parity byte +8 is no longer read.

edits.why: sltu v0,zero,v0 ; pedal case 6 (v0 = ctx+0x28, Roll; a1 = pressed 0/1): was "beq v0,zero,[address]"
beql v0,a1,[address] ; Roll already as the pedal wants: no call; was "li a1,0x1"
lui s0,0xa000 ; delay slot, taken only: as the call's delay slot [address]; was "move a0,s8" (a0 = s8 at [address])
jal 0x9d07aaf0 ; pad press in Pad Function mode 5, Roll on: was "li a0,0x28" (made by NOW); delay slot "move a1,s1" kept
sb v0,0x7(a3) ; delay slot of "b [address]": was "sb s6,0x7(a3)" (the full grid)
jal 0x9d07aaf0 ; pad press in mode 2 (16 Sounds): was "andi a1,t6,0xff"
delay slot: was "li a0,0x28" (made by NOW)
sb v0,0x7(a3) ; was "sb t5,0x7(a3)" (the full grid)
jal 0x9d07aaf0 ; pad press in mode 3: was "li a0,0x28" (made by NOW); delay slot "move a1,s0" kept
sb v0,0x7(a2) ; delay slot of "b [address]": was "sb s1,0x7(a2)" (the full grid)
jal 0x9d07ab98 ; [routine] after a retrigger (a0 = pad): was "jal [address]"; delay slot "addiu s2,s2,0x1" kept
sltu t0,s2,a3 ; next position < beat length: was "sltu t0,a3,s2"
movn s5,s2,t0 ; position + 1, or 0 at the length: was "movz s5,s2,t0" (the position reached the length)
lui t9,0xa000 ; press sites: v0 = ticks to the next grid point, a0 = 0x28; a1, a2, a3 kept
li a0,0x28 ; their LED command (was their "li a0,0x28")
lw v0,0x358(t9) ; delay slot: the position the next walk starts from
li v1,0x294 ; v0 = tick, t8 = beat
mfhi v0 ; t = tick mod length
lui t9,0xa001 ; v0 = t, v1 = length (0: no cap); uses t6, t8, t9; v0 = count
or t8,t9,zero ; delay slot: Q = grid
beq t9,zero,0x9d07ab80 ; (a grid of 0 is never in the table: count 0, no division)
mfhi t6 ; r = t mod P
subu t8,t8,t6 ; Q - r: the next point of this period
subu t8,t9,t6 ; past Q: P - r, the start of the next period
subu t9,v1,v0 ; delay slot: ticks to the beat end
movn t8,t9,t6 ; count = min(count, length - t)
move t7,ra ; [routine]: a0 = pad, s5 = position of this walk step, s7 = beat
addiu v0,s5,0x1 ; delay slot: the retrigger happens at position s5 + 1
sb v0,0x78e3(t8) ; delay slot: pad record +7 = ticks to the next grid point
